edits.old: Then the reconciliation reads no treatment or proceeds table
edits.new:
Then the reconciliation reads no treatment or proceeds table

  Scenario: AC15 Error answers of the provided operations are 401, 403 or 404
    Given a request to a provided operation of this service without credentials
    When the request is sent
    Then the answer is 401
    Given a request to a provided operation for a business date with no reconciliation result
    When the request is sent
    Then the answer is 404
    Given a request from a role without Platform administration R
    When the request is sent
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002, as in AC13

  Scenario: AC16 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the reconciliation activity fails or does not finish within its timeout
    When the workflow retries the activity
    Then the retry runs the reconciliation for the same business date and writes no row twice
    Then when the retries end, the run shows FAILED and the reason is carried on the run record

  Scenario: AC17 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given a request moves a status to a value the model does not allow
    When the request is sent
    Then the change is refused and no status is changed
